constant.value: The text written into the target, e.g. 351 for a despatch advice.

concatenate.inputCount: How many values are joined, from 2 to 10. Fewer parts remove the links into the parts that go away.
concatenate.separator: Written between the parts; leave empty to join them directly.

split.separator: The text the value is split at, e.g. a hyphen.
split.index: Which piece is kept, counted from 0.

substring.start: The first character kept, counted from 0.
substring.length: How many characters are kept; leave empty to keep the rest.

dateFormat.from: The pattern of the incoming date, from yyyy, yy, MM, dd, HH, mm and ss, e.g. yyyy-MM-dd.
dateFormat.to: The pattern written out, e.g. yyyyMMdd for EDIFACT format 102.

numberFormat.decimalPlaces: From 0 to 6; leave empty to keep the decimal places as they come.
numberFormat.decimalSeparator: The character between the whole number and its decimals.

lookupTable.lookupTableId: The Lookup Table that translates the value. A Workspace table serves every Trading Partner, a Trading Partner's table only that partner.
lookupTable.fallback: What happens when the Lookup Table has no entry for the value.

conditional.operator: How the Value input is checked. When the condition holds, Then is written, otherwise Else.
conditional.compareTo: The text the value is compared with, e.g. true.

loop.counterStart: The number of the first item; the Counter output numbers the items from here, e.g. for LIN.

jsonata.expression: A JSONata expression over the whole source Document, e.g. $sum(lines.lineAmount). Leaving the field, or Ctrl+Enter, saves it; Enter starts a new line.

lookupTables.error: The Lookup Tables could not be loaded.
lookupTables.empty: There are no Lookup Tables in this Workspace yet.
